Add Slide Background Images

pptx_section_slide.Rd

Returns a header (#, ##, …) with a provided background image

Usage

pptx_section_slide(level = 1, title, bg = NULL, include_html = TRUE, bg_dir)

Arguments

level

Header level numeric (1 = #, 2 = ##, etc.).

title

Slide title.

bg

The name of the background image file (without extension e.g., "blue" rather than "blue.png").

include_html

If TRUE, emit a header for HTML; otherwise suppress. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_dir

Directory containing background images.

Value

A knitr::asis_output() object.
